rules.statement: A verifier changed by the evaluated agent cannot authorize its own pass.
Reviewed governance generation preserves immutable history, emits canonical bytes before hashing and verifies publication with rollback on partial failure.
Traceability-sensitive CI jobs require complete Git history and signed release requires their direct success dependency.
Release CI must use the product-owned confirmed activation command and never hand-write activation fields.
Every cfg-enabled first-party test has a real Windows, Linux, or non-Linux-Unix CI execution target.
Runner-specific GitHub context must be evaluated at step scope, not job-level env scope.

Every production install, upgrade, uninstall, partial recovery and launcher preparation requires Yes.IsPresent; explicit -Yes:$false is rejected before path normalization or mutation. The persistent git_local_commit_v1 grant remains limited to the installed repository, branch, identity and local commit operation and never grants push, Full Access, arbitrary commands or ACL reset.

Upgrade diagnostics are advisory console phase/error facts only: there is no mutable fixed diagnostic file and no WMI/CIM query; heartbeat timeout retains the last rejected heartbeat reason plus a read-only Task Scheduler COM snapshot of registration, state, running instances and LastTaskResult, and no diagnostic result can replace independent receipt, journal, task, heartbeat or ready verification.

Every git_local_commit_v1 Git invocation is fixed, starts suspended in a single-process Job, terminates a pre-resume failure, disables indirect execution and network-capable helpers, and exposes no push, fetch, signing, hook, filter, editor, or arbitrary program dispatch.

Fresh install and upgrade require an independently committed clean source: every governed source is one normal H index entry at stage 0 whose mode and blob OID agree with HEAD and with the Git blob computed from the retained worktree bytes. Hidden index flags and status-hidden drift fail closed. One action-bound short-lived authority manifest and one held installer/source epoch remain under the installation mutex. Existing-install -Install is ordinary-user read-only identity_probe attestation. Task registration/start uses fixed Task Scheduler COM and no WINDIR-derived executable; a busy Check reads no mixed installation epoch. Main, crash and recovery SelfTest modes share one compact case-root constructor and enforce the deepest native-held worker path budget.

Installer rollback removes only exact transaction-owned objects. Normal uninstall snapshots every bounded non-reparse user-owned descendant before Task deletion, retains a DELETE-capable no-reparse handle with delete sharing denied for the root and every descendant directory, removes files under that held ancestor chain and deletes directories bottom-up through their original exact handles, and preserves concurrent leaf replacement, ancestor rename/junction substitution, external sentinels or unknown state.

git_local_commit_v1 failure before ref mutation preserves HEAD, live index, and worktree, while failure after ref mutation is forward-only, journaled, idempotent, and classified indeterminate whenever exact recovery cannot be proven.

git_local_commit_v1 binds one repository, direct main ref, signed and hash-bound direct Git, fixed author identity, exact configuration, absent info/attributes, and local-only standing-authority flags.

git_local_commit_v1 accepts only an exact expected-HEAD tracked-change snapshot, holds the registered root and every modified-file ancestor/leaf against namespace replacement, rejects junction/reparse traversal, and rejects arbitrary command, path, executable, ref, remote, environment, argv, duplicate JSON, untracked, staged, conflicted, or unsafe path input.

Upgrade stops only a receipt-bound orphan worker, preserves nonempty transaction journals, and clears interrupted staging only when exactly one extra hash-version and the complete protected tuple are proven beside the formal v2 worker.

retirement.reason: The former statement treated terminal verified journals as unresolved recovery evidence.

rules.statement: Upgrade stops only a receipt-bound orphan worker, preserves every active, nonterminal, mismatched or unknown transaction journal, and clears interrupted staging only for the exact protected tuple. A current-schema upgrade may retire only terminal verified commit journals whose immutable success results and absent request/scratch state match under the exclusive transaction lock.

retirement.reason: Terminal recovery now distinguishes exact inherited worker artifacts from mixed ACL drift.

rules.statement: Upgrade stops only a receipt-bound orphan worker, preserves every active, nonterminal, mismatched or unknown transaction journal, and clears interrupted staging only for the exact protected tuple. A current-schema upgrade may retire only terminal verified commit journals whose immutable success results and absent request/scratch state match under the exclusive transaction lock, and whose held journal/result ACL is either canonical protected or an all-inherited semantic match under its exact protected parent; mixed ACLs and any identity, content or security drift remain recovery evidence.

git_local_commit_v1 hashes held bytes through the protected attributes, rejects symbolic registered refs, stages the verified index under standard index.lock, uses no-deref ref CAS, proves the replaced-index backup, and verifies exact clean commit output.

Fresh install and schema-v3 upgrade use only clean independently committed source bytes held by the action-bound authority. Upgrade retains journaled crash recovery, nonce-before-stop, receipt probes, bounded heartbeat diagnostics, ready-last publication and exact current-schema rollback/forward recovery without production GetNewClosure.

Install and upgrade publish no mutable launcher: one profile-free conversation command pins runtime, installer and action-specific nonce manifest; the administrator independently holds Goal, pending and the complete clean HEAD/status/Git-input epoch before any source query, then holds all governed sources and proves each is one normal stage-0 HEAD blob from the retained bytes, never executes workspace-built Rayman, and rejects hidden index flags, stale, mismatched-action or replayed authority.

Only a same-session, same-turn, structurally correlated and recent functions.exec yielded-cell output can authorize functions.wait; mismatched, stale, completed, failed, malformed, prose-only, or not-found evidence is denied before dispatch with direct collaboration correction.

The project Hook is additive to the user Stop Hook, remains record-only until fresh canonical wait coverage is observed and human-trusted, reinjects routing context on supported lifecycle events, and binds every handler to the exact guard script bytes.
Context delivery cursors bind schema, snapshot, normalized query, deterministic sort, and next position; malformed, non-canonical, or drifted cursors fail closed.

Budgeted context delivery emits canonical UTF-8 JSON with navigation_only authority, snapshot/query/sort identities, exact budget/count invariants, one cursor-paginated stream of resolved or unresolved provenance records, and portable workspace-relative paths; invalid records, silent truncation, and budget overflow fail closed.

The shared producer selects the largest complete advancing prefix under exact canonical UTF-8 bytes, reports full counts and one cursor stream, permits page-control retries, and fails closed when no complete next record fits.

Standalone context refresh rejects and preserves semantically invalid compatible caches, publishes only after two equal full strong-content captures, and reports actual files_hashed/bytes_hashed separately from content_unchanged/content_changed; legacy reused/rehashed equal only those content classifications.

Budgeted Context overview, query, excerpt, and pack commands bind the verified context index and raw index bytes, expose complete provenance records with safe filters, field projection, budget and cursor controls, verified UTF-8 content or unresolved records, and fail closed on stale or unsafe input while remaining navigation_only.
